answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using proof of burn. Each node irreversibly destroys tokens into an unspendable ember sink to generate a verifiable burn receipt. Network peers harbor these records to ensure an adversary cannot echo one payment across multiple synthetic identities, forcing attackers to sacrifice scarce financial capital per identity. However, wealthy entities can absorb these non-recoverable costs to mint multiple Sybils, marginalizing smaller participants.
